statement: The dependence-safe square-collision Riesz energy is uniformly finite for every exponent 0<alpha<1, but the alpha=1 endpoint fails even for X uniform on [-1/2,1/2]: E|X^2-X'^2|^{-1}=infinity. Therefore a proof cannot obtain an unweighted L2 time-integral endpoint from one square collision alone. This does not refute QFORM.
scope: Intermediate one-square independent-copy endpoint only; full QFORM remains open.
